title: Verify Anomaly public demo in the installed agent pipeline

kickbacks.reason: Precondition 3 and runbook step 3 are not executable for the final task-28 candidate: the repository contains no supported OMP/Pi installable package or manifest. OMP refuses the candidate because package.json is absent; Pi treats the raw skill/reviewer directories as extensions and cannot load either. The plan must name a real checked-in installer/uninstaller and a harness registration/resolution seam for both anomaly and anomaly-data-reviewer (or depend on a task that supplies them) before the canonical demo can proceed.

blockedReason: Awaiting a supported checked-in Anomaly installer/uninstaller and harness registration/resolution seam; the recorded execute return proved the current candidate is not installable by OMP or Pi.

slices: Bind the install to task 27 and exact-candidate green suite evidence.
Create isolated HOME/case roots and register the candidate in the supported harness.
Exercise Gate A, detectors, draft/replay, one restart/resume, fresh P5/P6 review, Gate B, report, and charts.
Verify portable evidence and remove only isolated managed installation state while retaining the usable case.
runbook: Read task 27's successful terminal record; match its exact candidate revision/digest to zero-exit candidate-targeted and full-suite receipts.
Create fresh isolated HOME and portable case roots; copy the checked-in demo CSV into the case by relative path.
Use the supported installer/registration path under isolated HOME; resolve the Anomaly dispatcher and independent reviewer manifest through the supported harness.
Drive create, source registration, preparation/profile, recommendation, and explicit Gate A approval; require the gate turn to end before detectors.
Run detectors and create draft/replay state; record durable state, accepted attempt IDs, artifacts, and draft hash.
Restart the harness exactly once, resume the same case, and require accepted work to be reused from authoritative durable state.
Run P5/P6 in a distinct fresh reviewer context, capture matching draft-hash attestation, then provide explicit Gate B approval in its own turn.
Generate report/charts and inspect state/attempt evidence, gate receipts, reviewer attestation, outputs, and recorded paths.
Require every case path to be relative and contained; scan retained artifacts for the absolute case-root prefix and credential material with zero matches.
Run supported uninstall against isolated HOME only; prove isolated registrations/files are gone, ambient state is unchanged, and the retained case remains readable.
preconditions: Task 27 has a terminal successful result for the same candidate revision/digest to be installed.
Candidate-targeted checks and the full repository suite have zero-exit receipts bound to that exact revision/digest.
The checked-in demo CSV, supported installer/uninstaller, supported harness, and candidate package are locally available without network acquisition.
Fresh non-overlapping HOME/case paths are available, and ambient installation state can be inventoried read-only.
plan.recoveryBoundary: Stop on any candidate mismatch, write outside isolated HOME/case roots, improperly closed gate, repeated accepted work after restart, reviewer/hash mismatch, or cleanup target outside isolated state. Preserve the case and operation log; recovery may remove only isolated HOME and must not rewrite candidate, ambient state, or case.
plan.approvalBoundary: No approval boundary: all mutations must remain inside the isolated HOME and portable case roots; stop before any external or shared mutation.
postconditions: Task 27 and both suite receipts are successful for the installed candidate identity.
The supported harness resolves dispatcher and reviewer from isolated HOME, with ambient state unchanged.
The durable case records the complete workflow, explicit Gate A/Gate B receipts, report, and charts in valid order.
Exactly one fresh harness session resumes from the authoritative next action without rerunning accepted work.
A distinct fresh reviewer context attests the exact durable draft hash before Gate B.
All recorded case paths are relative, contained, present, and retained artifacts contain neither the absolute case-root prefix nor credential material.
Uninstall removes isolated managed state only, ambient state is unchanged, and the retained case remains readable with state/report/charts intact.
verificationSeams: Compare task 27 and both suite receipt revision/digest fields byte-for-byte with installed identity; require zero exit statuses.
Resolve both components under isolated HOME and compare pre/post ambient installation inventories byte-for-byte.
Walk durable state/event/attempt records; cross-check receipts and outputs, requiring no detector before Gate A and no final output before Gate B.
Compare pre-stop/post-resume snapshots: stable accepted IDs/hashes/artifacts, exactly one changed harness session identity, and first new event equal to recorded next action.
Require unequal orchestrator/reviewer context identities, byte-equal attested/durable draft hashes, and attestation ordered before Gate B receipt.
Containment-check every relative path and require targets; byte-scan retained artifacts for the exact absolute root and credential/token/private-key patterns with zero matches.
Require isolated registrations/files absent, ambient inventories byte-identical, and reopen/read retained state, report, and every chart.

actions: Checked the current execute plan, repository rules, final task-28/pruned provenance, and exact-candidate full-suite receipt before mutation.
Captured the ambient OMP plugin inventory read-only.
Created fresh non-overlapping isolated HOME and portable case roots under /tmp/anomaly-public-demo.MUG1i9.
Copied the checked-in canonical demo CSV to the case-relative path input/orchestration_demo.csv.
Attempted the supported OMP local installer under isolated HOME; it failed because the candidate has no package.json.

Tried Pi's supported installer against the checked-in skill and reviewer paths under isolated HOME; Pi registered both as extensions and reported that neither could be loaded, so the dispatcher/reviewer registration precondition was not satisfied.
Removed both failed Pi registrations using the supported uninstaller.
Removed only the isolated HOME in accordance with the recovery boundary; retained the portable case for diagnosis.
Verified the retained canonical CSV by SHA-256 and verified the ambient OMP plugin inventory remained unchanged.
